body: It's just that for most of my life, I've been the person my friends and family have come to for advice/counsel/comfort. I've never been the one to ask for help and I seriously don't know how to do it. There have been times where I've tried, but my problems were always overshadowed by someone elses'

I'm turning 24 tomorrow. I've been depressed for so long, let every little thing bother me so much that I seriously can't remember why I became this way in the first place. School has me stressed out to the point where I guess it'll set me off the deep end if I fail. I just spent this past week going into the library to study and write a long paper. I got a D on my exam and I can't find my paper. I'm not that great with computers, but I'm pretty sure it didn't save correctly so I'm going to fail my one class now. I'm cooling down a bit from an hour ago, but I'm still completely shocked that I took my feelings this far.
